items.title: Congress’s 2027 budget could include new funding for Long COVID and ME
items.summary:
Advocates are calling on senators and representatives to include the ME/CFS Research Roadmap and new Long COVID funding in the fiscal year 2027 budget as legislators debate appropriations bills in the coming weeks.
